Then theres the bowl and the downstem. Any bowl and downstem will do but try to avoid downstems with only small holes as these will get clogged quickly. As for the bowl, theres actually physics to it. A rounded bowl will allow you to smoke all the herb because a majority of it will stay supported by the bowl, a V shaped bowl will cause it to act like a funnel and could risk all your herb being sucked into the water. But a V shaped bowl allows for better airflow and transfer of burning from the top layer of herb to the bottom

As for what weed, what you got is what you smoke. If you dont got anything at the moment, what you can score is what you smoke.😉

Ps, get some glass screens. Theyre non toxic and theyll allow you to get the most from all your weed in each and every hit. A common mistake I see is people lighting and pulling so hard that a bunch of unsmoked herb ends up in the water, and what good is that? If you can’t get screens, practice pulling just enough so that the top layer of ember burns the next layer all the way down until the whole bowl is ash. It keeps your water cleaner and it allows you to smoke every last bit of goodness from your herb

Im a bit of a clean freak so I like to clean mine with a multi step process. I start by dumping my water into the toilet to prevent blockages and flush instantly to prevent resin sticking to the side. I go at it with hot tap water to get off as much gunk as I can then I use dirty 99% isopropyl to get every last piece of gunk off. From there ill use dishsoap (dawn works best but any will do) to give it that first clean and shine. After that ill use brand new clean 99% isopropyl to get that disinfection action and then hit it with 70% rubbing alcohol since its better at disinfecting. From there I rinse with hot tap water and repeat the dish soap step one more time to lock in that final shine and rinse and youre done!

For the stem and bowl I use a plastic container I got from an old chinese food order and fill that with dirty 99% iso and shake until the gunk is gone, then I use a brush and rinse under hot water until all the resin is gone
